Hansel "BnTeT" Ferdinand (born August 28, 1995) is an Indonesian professional Counter-Strike 2 player and former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player. He is well known for being the best player from Indonesia and is also regarded as one of the best in Asia.

Trivia

[edit]
  • According to daps, BnTeT was being considered as NRG Esports' fifth player to replace FugLy in early 2019, if the organization were unable to acquire tarik from MIBR. [3]
